page.overview:
Who is Ardan?

Ardan was a Human male native of the Core World Brentaal IV and a lieutenant commander of the Imperial Navy during the height of the Galactic Civil War. He participated in the Imperial subjugations of the planets Ithor, Kashyyyk, Firro, Sinton, and other worlds populated by non-Humans. Ardan later commanded the bridge pit crews of the Super Star Destroyer Executor, the flagship of the Dark Lord Darth Vader, during the events leading up to the Battle of Hoth.

The Human male Ardan was a veteran of the Imperial war machine dating back to the Empire's initial subjugation of the planet Kashyyyk He also participated in the Imperial conquests of Ithor, Firro, Sinton, and other non-Human-populated worlds.

By 3 ABY, Ardan served with the Imperial Death Squadron as a lieutenant commander aboard the Super Star Destroyer Executor, the personal flagship of Darth Vader. Ardan commanded the Executor bridge pit crews.

Ardan was present within the Executor starboard-side crew pit when Vader strode purposefully across the bridge's command walkway to discuss the findings of a reconnaissance Viper probe droid in the Hoth system with Admiral Kendal Ozzel and Captain Firmus Piett. Ardan, along with the rest of the crewmen within the command pit, The probe droid's data revealed the location of Echo Base, the Rebel Alliance's hidden headquarters on the planet Hoth, leading to the Executor participation in the subsequent Battle of Hoth.
